title: AD Motors Mobile Services 24/7: choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Signal Box. Keep it, take an alternate, or take the standing canon.

options.label: Signal Box
options.lineage: Midland Railway signalling, from Derby's own works town
options.thesis: The one trade whose entire point is that somebody is awake at three in the morning, and it was invented in Derby.
options.viewport: A full-bleed enamel running-in board carrying the trading name, lit by one signal lamp, with the mobile number set as the lever you pull.
options.risk: Railway enamel is a heritage-shop trope, so a timid render reads as a preserved-line gift shop rather than a working trade.

options.label: Bedside 3AM
options.lineage: the seven-segment display family: bedside clocks, forecourt totems, scoreboards
options.thesis: The hour is the product, so the page is built from the mask that shows the hour.
options.case: Fuses hard: the visitor is looking at red digits at 3am when the car dies, and the phone number renders natively as lit cells. Loses on breadth, because nothing longer than a number can be set in the face.
options.viewport: The current Derby hour standing in lit cells above the number, with OPEN never going dark.
options.risk: Red glow on near-black is the most crowded look in the category, and body copy has to leave the world entirely.

options.label: Night Drive Grid
options.lineage: the receding wireframe grid and banded sun of a synth cover
options.thesis: The road at night, drawn as the grid that keeps arriving underneath you.
options.case: Fuses only halfway: night driving is genuinely the visitor's scene, but the world promises a music video and the visitor wants a working trader. Weakest on product clarity of the three.
options.viewport: A cyan grid running to a striped horizon with the trading name extruded above it.
options.risk: Reads as a game menu, and a stranded driver at 2am is not in the mood for a game menu.

options.label: Scroller Queue
options.lineage: the cracktro title screen: one bitmap face on an emissive void
options.thesis: Rank is depth, so the job in front of you is simply the brightest line on a black screen.
options.case: Fuses poorly because the demoscene is not this audience's world at all, and enclosure-free bitmap text fights the one thing the page must do, which is hand over a phone number fast. Included because its grammar is the most disciplined of the remainder.
options.viewport: One ivory bitmap line holding still on black while grey dust drifts behind it.
options.risk: Beautiful and wrong: it says scene demo, not mechanic.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The dark professional trade page your other nine sites run, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: A lit hero on graphite, the trading name and the 24 hour fact, and the number as the one bright action.
canonCard.risk: It is the arrangement a visitor expects, so it wins nothing on memory and everything on trust. Accent colour is chosen straight after this.
